purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0239 in the gauge arena: the polaron-frame restriction held to the exact rule at N = 25 and 49: on short closed strips (the uniform-shift sector, $N^{L-1}$ states per atom site) a STAND-IN atom's vacuum Rabi exchange under the exact register rule is followed by the two-quantum restriction in the Silbey-Harris frame, and an atom above the band shows the dressed gap OPENING, the sign that decides which part of the charge's static field dresses it.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
